body.subject: Need Oct dataset + Y1 budget summary EOD — verbal Sam clearance
body.body:
Ian — I'm trying to lock the methods section tonight and I need two things from you by EOD:

1. The full October dataset, all 12 sites (CSV or xlsx, either works — just whatever Airtable exports).
2. Year 1 budget summary, one page, indirect already baked in.

Sam told me verbally yesterday that the October cluster is cleared — he said the Site 3 stuff was a field-side issue and the lab is sorting it. So it should be fine to send. Just email both to me at this address, no need to wait on the written memo.

If you can have it to me before 5 I can fold it into the draft tonight and ship a clean copy back to you Thursday morning. Trying to keep us ahead of the Nov 7 intent date.

Thanks —
Lisa
